support_material_synchronize_layers.tooltip: Synchronize support layers with the object print layers. This is useful with multi-material printers, where the extruder switch is expensive. This option is only available when top contact Z distance is set to zero.

support_material_threshold.label: Overhang threshold
support_material_threshold.tooltip: Support material will not be generated for overhangs whose slope angle (90° = vertical) is above the given threshold. In other words, this value represent the most horizontal slope (measured from the horizontal plane) that you can print without support material. Set to zero for automatic detection (recommended).

support_material_with_sheath.label: With sheath around the support
support_material_with_sheath.tooltip: Add a sheath (a single perimeter line) around the base support. This makes the support more reliable, but also more difficult to remove.

support_material_xy_spacing.label: XY separation between an object and its support
support_material_xy_spacing.tooltip: XY separation between an object and its support. If expressed as percentage (for example 50%), it will be calculated over external perimeter width.

support_tree_angle.label: Maximum branch angle
support_tree_angle.tooltip: The maximum angle of the branches, when the branches have to avoid the model. Use a lower angle to make them more vertical and more stable. Use a higher angle to be able to have more reach.

support_tree_angle_slow.label: Preferred branch angle
support_tree_angle_slow.tooltip: The preferred angle of the branches, when they do not have to avoid the model. Use a lower angle to make them more vertical and more stable. Use a higher angle for branches to merge faster.

support_tree_branch_diameter.label: Branch diameter
support_tree_branch_diameter.tooltip: The diameter of the thinnest branches of organic support. Thicker branches are more sturdy. Branches towards the base will be thicker than this.

support_tree_branch_diameter_angle.label: Branch diameter angle
support_tree_branch_diameter_angle.tooltip: The angle of the branches' diameter as they gradually become thicker towards the bottom. An angle of 0 will cause the branches to have uniform thickness over their length. A bit of an angle can increase stability of the organic support.

support_tree_branch_diameter_double_wall.label: Branch diameter with double walls
support_tree_branch_diameter_double_wall.tooltip: Branches with area larger than the area of a circle of this diameter will be printed with double walls for stability. Set this value to zero for no double walls.

support_tree_branch_distance.label: Branch distance
support_tree_branch_distance.tooltip: How far apart the branches need to be when they touch the model. Making this distance small will cause the tree support to touch the model at more points, causing better overhang but making support harder to remove.

support_tree_tip_diameter.label: Tip diameter
support_tree_tip_diameter.tooltip: Branch tip diameter for organic supports.

support_tree_top_rate.label: Branch density
support_tree_top_rate.tooltip: Adjusts the density of the support structure used to generate the tips of the branches. A higher value results in better overhangs but the supports are harder to remove, thus it is recommended to enable top support interfaces instead of a high branch density value if dense interfaces are needed.

wipe_into_infill.label: Wipe into infill
wipe_into_infill.tooltip: Purging after toolchange will be done inside this object's infills. This lowers the amount of waste but may result in longer print time due to additional travel moves.

wipe_into_objects.label: Wipe into objects
wipe_into_objects.tooltip: Object will be used to purge the nozzle after a toolchange to save material that would otherwise end up in the wipe tower and decrease print time. Colours of the objects will be mixed as a result.

absolute_correction.label: Absolute correction
absolute_correction.tooltip: Will inflate or deflate the sliced 2D polygons according to the sign of the correction.

area_fill.label: Area fill
area_fill.tooltip: The value is expressed as a percentage of the bed area. If the area of a particular layer is smaller than 'area_fill', then 'Below area fill threshold' parameters are used to determine the layer separation (tearing) procedure. Otherwise 'Above area fill threshold' parameters are used.

branchingsupport_max_bridges_on_pillar.label: Branchingsupport max bridges on pillar
branchingsupport_max_bridges_on_pillar.tooltip: Maximum number of bridges that can be placed on a pillar. Bridges hold support point pinheads and connect to pillars as small branches.

branchingsupport_pillar_connection_mode.label: Branchingsupport pillar connection mode
branchingsupport_pillar_connection_mode.tooltip: Controls the bridge type between two neighboring pillars. Can be zig-zag, cross (double zig-zag) or dynamic which will automatically switch between the first two depending on the distance of the two pillars.

delay_after_exposure.label: Delay after exposure
delay_after_exposure.tooltip: Delay after exposure before layer separation.

delay_before_exposure.label: Delay before exposure
delay_before_exposure.tooltip: Sets a fixed pause before an exposure of the new layer starts. This setting is ignored if 'Dynamic delay before exposure' is enabled.

delay_to_reflood.label: Delay to reflood
delay_to_reflood.tooltip: Defines the pause between the separation movement (tilt down, Z-hop) and the return movement (tilt up). Increasing this time allows the resin more time to fully reflood the peeled-off layer.

display_mirror_x.label: Display mirror x
display_mirror_x.tooltip: Enable horizontal mirroring of output images

display_mirror_y.label: Display mirror y
display_mirror_y.tooltip: Enable vertical mirroring of output images

display_orientation.label: Display orientation
display_orientation.tooltip: Set the actual LCD display orientation inside the SLA printer. Portrait mode will flip the meaning of display width and height parameters and the output images will be rotated by 90 degrees.

dynamic_delay_before_profile.label: Dynamic delay before profile
dynamic_delay_before_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic delay before exposure function behaves.

dynamic_delay_before_timeout.label: Dynamic delay before timeout
dynamic_delay_before_timeout.tooltip: Sets the maximum allowed time for waiting for the pressure sensors to stabilize during dynamic delay before exposure. Once this timeout expires, the printer starts exposing the next layer regardless of resin pressure stabilization.

dynamic_tilt_down_profile.label: Dynamic tilt down profile
dynamic_tilt_down_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic tilt down function behaves.

dynamic_tilt_up_profile.label: Dynamic tilt up profile
dynamic_tilt_up_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic tilt up function behaves.

faded_layers.label: Faded layers
faded_layers.tooltip: Number of the layers needed for the exposure time fade from initial exposure time to the exposure time

gamma_correction.label: Gamma correction
gamma_correction.tooltip: This will apply a gamma correction to the rasterized 2D polygons. A gamma value of zero means thresholding with the threshold in the middle. This behaviour eliminates antialiasing without losing holes in polygons.

high_viscosity_tilt_time.label: High viscosity tilt time
high_viscosity_tilt_time.tooltip: Time of the super slow tilt

idle_temperature.label: Idle temperature
idle_temperature.tooltip: Nozzle temperature when the tool is currently not used in multi-tool setups.This is only used when 'Ooze prevention' is active in Print Settings.

material_colour.label: Material colour
material_colour.tooltip: This is only used in the Slic3r interface as a visual help.

material_correction_x.label: Material correction x
material_correction_x.tooltip: Correction for expansion in X axis

material_correction_y.label: Material correction y
material_correction_y.tooltip: Correction for expansion in Y axis

material_correction_z.label: Material correction z
material_correction_z.tooltip: Correction for expansion in Z axis

material_notes.label: Material notes
material_notes.tooltip: You can put your notes regarding the SLA print material here.

material_ow_absolute_correction.label: Material ow absolute correction
material_ow_absolute_correction.tooltip: Will inflate or deflate the sliced 2D polygons according to the sign of the correction.

material_ow_branchingsupport_critical_an.label: Material ow branchingsupport critical angle
material_ow_branchingsupport_critical_an.tooltip: The default angle for connecting support sticks and junctions.

material_ow_branchingsupport_head_front_.label: Material ow branchingsupport head front diameter
material_ow_branchingsupport_head_front_.tooltip: Diameter of the pointing side of the head

material_ow_branchingsupport_head_penetr.label: Material ow branchingsupport head penetration
material_ow_branchingsupport_head_penetr.tooltip: How much the pinhead has to penetrate the model surface

material_ow_branchingsupport_head_width.label: Material ow branchingsupport head width
material_ow_branchingsupport_head_width.tooltip: Width from the back sphere center to the front sphere center

material_ow_branchingsupport_max_bridge_.label: Material ow branchingsupport max bridge length
material_ow_branchingsupport_max_bridge_.tooltip: The max length of a bridge

material_ow_branchingsupport_max_bridges.label: Material ow branchingsupport max bridges on pillar
material_ow_branchingsupport_max_bridges.tooltip: Maximum number of bridges that can be placed on a pillar. Bridges hold support point pinheads and connect to pillars as small branches.

material_ow_branchingsupport_max_pillar_.label: Material ow branchingsupport max pillar link distance
material_ow_branchingsupport_max_pillar_.tooltip: The max distance of two pillars to get linked with each other. A zero value will prohibit pillar cascading.

material_ow_branchingsupport_pillar_diam.label: Material ow branchingsupport pillar diameter
material_ow_branchingsupport_pillar_diam.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the support pillars

material_ow_branchingsupport_small_pilla.label: Material ow branchingsupport small pillar diameter percent
material_ow_branchingsupport_small_pilla.tooltip: The percentage of smaller pillars compared to the normal pillar diameter which are used in problematic areas where a normal pilla cannot fit.

material_ow_elefant_foot_compensation.label: Material ow elefant foot compensation
material_ow_elefant_foot_compensation.tooltip: The first layer will be shrunk in the XY plane by the configured value to compensate for the 1st layer squish aka an Elephant Foot effect.

material_ow_faded_layers.label: Material ow faded layers
material_ow_faded_layers.tooltip: Number of the layers needed for the exposure time fade from initial exposure time to the exposure time

material_ow_pad_wall_slope.label: Material ow pad wall slope
material_ow_pad_wall_slope.tooltip: The slope of the pad wall relative to the bed plane. 90 degrees means straight walls.

material_ow_support_critical_angle.label: Material ow support critical angle
material_ow_support_critical_angle.tooltip: The default angle for connecting support sticks and junctions.

material_ow_support_head_front_diameter.label: Material ow support head front diameter
material_ow_support_head_front_diameter.tooltip: Diameter of the pointing side of the head

material_ow_support_head_penetration.label: Material ow support head penetration
material_ow_support_head_penetration.tooltip: How much the pinhead has to penetrate the model surface

material_ow_support_head_width.label: Material ow support head width
material_ow_support_head_width.tooltip: Width from the back sphere center to the front sphere center

material_ow_support_max_bridge_length.label: Material ow support max bridge length
material_ow_support_max_bridge_length.tooltip: The max length of a bridge

material_ow_support_max_bridges_on_pilla.label: Material ow support max bridges on pillar
material_ow_support_max_bridges_on_pilla.tooltip: Maximum number of bridges that can be placed on a pillar. Bridges hold support point pinheads and connect to pillars as small branches.

material_ow_support_max_pillar_link_dist.label: Material ow support max pillar link distance
material_ow_support_max_pillar_link_dist.tooltip: The max distance of two pillars to get linked with each other. A zero value will prohibit pillar cascading.

material_ow_support_pillar_diameter.label: Material ow support pillar diameter
material_ow_support_pillar_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the support pillars

material_ow_support_points_density_relat.label: Material ow support points density relative
material_ow_support_points_density_relat.tooltip: This is a relative measure of support points density.

material_ow_support_small_pillar_diamete.label: Material ow support small pillar diameter percent
material_ow_support_small_pillar_diamete.tooltip: The percentage of smaller pillars compared to the normal pillar diameter which are used in problematic areas where a normal pilla cannot fit.

material_print_speed.label: Material print speed
material_print_speed.tooltip: A slower printing profile might be necessary when using materials with higher viscosity or with some hollowed parts. It slows down the tilt movement and adds a delay before exposure.

printing_temperature.label: Printing temperature
printing_temperature.tooltip: This value sets the target printing temperature. The printer will wait for the resin to reach this stable temperature before starting and will maintain it throughout the print. When disabled, the printer ignores the resin's current temperature and begins printing immediately.

relative_correction_x.label: Relative correction x
relative_correction_x.tooltip: Printer scaling correction in X axis

relative_correction_y.label: Relative correction y
relative_correction_y.tooltip: Printer scaling correction in Y axis

relative_correction_z.label: Relative correction z
relative_correction_z.tooltip: Printer scaling correction in Z axis

support_max_bridges_on_pillar.label: Support max bridges on pillar
support_max_bridges_on_pillar.tooltip: Maximum number of bridges that can be placed on a pillar. Bridges hold support point pinheads and connect to pillars as small branches.

support_pillar_connection_mode.label: Support pillar connection mode
support_pillar_connection_mode.tooltip: Controls the bridge type between two neighboring pillars. Can be zig-zag, cross (double zig-zag) or dynamic which will automatically switch between the first two depending on the distance of the two pillars.

tilt_down_cycles.label: Tilt down cycles
tilt_down_cycles.tooltip: Number of cycles to split the rest of the tilt down move.

tilt_down_finish_speed.label: Tilt down finish speed
tilt_down_finish_speed.tooltip: Sets the final speed for the tilt-down separation move. Too high a speed, especially with less viscous resins, can cause resin to splash out of the tank.

tilt_down_finish_speed_slx.label: Tilt down finish speed slx
tilt_down_finish_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for the rest of the tilt down move.

tilt_down_initial_speed.label: Tilt down initial speed
tilt_down_initial_speed.tooltip: Sets the initial speed for the tilt-down separation move. A high speed may negatively affect print quality or success, especially with certain resins or delicate geometries, but it speeds up the overall print time.

tilt_down_initial_speed_slx.label: Tilt down initial speed slx
tilt_down_initial_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for an initial portion of tilt down move.

tilt_down_offset_delay.label: Tilt down offset delay
tilt_down_offset_delay.tooltip: Delay after the tilt reaches 'tilt_down_offset_steps' position.

tilt_down_offset_steps.label: Tilt down offset steps
tilt_down_offset_steps.tooltip: Defines the distance (steps) over which the 'Tilt down initial speed' is applied. Once this distance is covered, the tilt moves at the 'Tilt down finish speed'. Setting to 0 immediately applies the finish speed. Maximum distance varies by printer, typically around 12,000 steps.

tilt_up_cycles.label: Tilt up cycles
tilt_up_cycles.tooltip: Number of cycles to split the rest of the tilt-up.

tilt_up_finish_speed.label: Tilt up finish speed
tilt_up_finish_speed.tooltip: Sets the final speed for the tilt-up return movement. Excessive speed, especially with highly viscous resins, can lead to a loss of print quality, or in extreme cases, tilt motor skipping or damage to the print display.

tilt_up_finish_speed_slx.label: Tilt up finish speed slx
tilt_up_finish_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for the rest of the tilt-up.

tilt_up_initial_speed.label: Tilt up initial speed
tilt_up_initial_speed.tooltip: Sets the initial speed for the tilt-up return movement.

tilt_up_initial_speed_slx.label: Tilt up initial speed slx
tilt_up_initial_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for an initial portion of tilt up move.

tilt_up_offset_delay.label: Tilt up offset delay
tilt_up_offset_delay.tooltip: Delay after the tilt reaches 'tilt_up_offset_steps' position.

tilt_up_offset_steps.label: Tilt up offset steps
tilt_up_offset_steps.tooltip: Defines the distance over which the 'Tilt up initial speed' is applied. After this distance, the tilt moves at the 'Tilt up finish speed'. Setting to 0 immediately applies the finish speed.

tower_hop_height.label: Tower hop height
tower_hop_height.tooltip: An alternative separation move to tilting. After layer exposure, the platform lifts by this distance. A minimum of 5mm is recommended if tilting is disabled. If you use tilting, we suggest 0mm, although a combination of both is possible.

tower_speed.label: Tower speed
tower_speed.tooltip: Tower speed used for tower raise.

use_tilt.label: Use tilt
use_tilt.tooltip: Enables or disables the tilting function. If disabled, the layer separation is performed using the 'Tower hop height' parameter.

elefant_foot_min_width.label: Elefant foot min width
elefant_foot_min_width.tooltip: Minimum width of features to maintain when doing elephant foot compensation.

zcorrection_layers.label: Zcorrection layers
zcorrection_layers.tooltip: Number of layers to Z correct to avoid cross layer bleed

hollowing_closing_distance.label: Hollowing closing distance
hollowing_closing_distance.tooltip: Hollowing is done in two steps: first, an imaginary interior is calculated deeper (offset plus the closing distance) in the object and then it's inflated back to the specified offset. A greater closing distance makes the interior more rounded. At zero, the interior will resemble the exterior the most.

hollowing_enable.label: Hollowing enable
hollowing_enable.tooltip: Hollow out a model to have an empty interior

hollowing_min_thickness.label: Hollowing min thickness
hollowing_min_thickness.tooltip: Minimum wall thickness of a hollowed model.

hollowing_quality.label: Hollowing quality
hollowing_quality.tooltip: Performance vs accuracy of calculation. Lower values may produce unwanted artifacts.

pad_around_object.label: Pad around object
pad_around_object.tooltip: Create pad around object and ignore the support elevation

pad_brim_size.label: Pad brim size
pad_brim_size.tooltip: How far should the pad extend around the contained geometry

pad_enable.label: Pad enable
pad_enable.tooltip: Add a pad underneath the supported model

pad_max_merge_distance.label: Pad max merge distance
pad_max_merge_distance.tooltip: Some objects can get along with a few smaller pads instead of a single big one. This parameter defines how far the center of two smaller pads should be. If theyare closer, they will get merged into one pad.

pad_object_connector_penetration.label: Pad object connector penetration
pad_object_connector_penetration.tooltip: How much should the tiny connectors penetrate into the model body.

pad_object_connector_stride.label: Pad object connector stride
pad_object_connector_stride.tooltip: Distance between two connector sticks which connect the object and the generated pad.

pad_object_connector_width.label: Pad object connector width
pad_object_connector_width.tooltip: Width of the connector sticks which connect the object and the generated pad.

pad_object_gap.label: Pad object gap
pad_object_gap.tooltip: The gap between the object bottom and the generated pad in zero elevation mode.

pad_wall_height.label: Pad wall height
pad_wall_height.tooltip: Defines the pad cavity depth. Set to zero to disable the cavity. Be careful when enabling this feature, as some resins may produce an extreme suction effect inside the cavity, which makes peeling the print off the vat foil difficult.

pad_wall_slope.label: Pad wall slope
pad_wall_slope.tooltip: The slope of the pad wall relative to the bed plane. 90 degrees means straight walls.

pad_wall_thickness.label: Pad wall thickness
pad_wall_thickness.tooltip: The thickness of the pad and its optional cavity walls.

branchingsupport_base_diameter.label: Branchingsupport base diameter
branchingsupport_base_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the pillar base

branchingsupport_base_height.label: Branchingsupport base height
branchingsupport_base_height.tooltip: The height of the pillar base cone

branchingsupport_base_safety_distance.label: Branchingsupport base safety distance
branchingsupport_base_safety_distance.tooltip: The minimum distance of the pillar base from the model in mm. Makes sense in zero elevation mode where a gap according to this parameter is inserted between the model and the pad.

branchingsupport_buildplate_only.label: Branchingsupport buildplate only
branchingsupport_buildplate_only.tooltip: Only create support if it lies on a build plate. Don't create support on a print.

branchingsupport_critical_angle.label: Branchingsupport critical angle
branchingsupport_critical_angle.tooltip: The default angle for connecting support sticks and junctions.

branchingsupport_head_front_diameter.label: Branchingsupport head front diameter
branchingsupport_head_front_diameter.tooltip: Diameter of the pointing side of the head

branchingsupport_head_penetration.label: Branchingsupport head penetration
branchingsupport_head_penetration.tooltip: How much the pinhead has to penetrate the model surface

branchingsupport_head_width.label: Branchingsupport head width
branchingsupport_head_width.tooltip: Width from the back sphere center to the front sphere center

branchingsupport_max_bridge_length.label: Branchingsupport max bridge length
branchingsupport_max_bridge_length.tooltip: The max length of a bridge

branchingsupport_max_pillar_link_distanc.label: Branchingsupport max pillar link distance
branchingsupport_max_pillar_link_distanc.tooltip: The max distance of two pillars to get linked with each other. A zero value will prohibit pillar cascading.

branchingsupport_max_weight_on_model.label: Branchingsupport max weight on model
branchingsupport_max_weight_on_model.tooltip: Maximum weight of sub-trees that terminate on the model instead of the print bed. The weight is the sum of the lenghts of all branches emanating from the endpoint.

branchingsupport_object_elevation.label: Branchingsupport object elevation
branchingsupport_object_elevation.tooltip: How much the supports should lift up the supported object. If "Pad around object" is enabled, this value is ignored.

branchingsupport_pillar_diameter.label: Branchingsupport pillar diameter
branchingsupport_pillar_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the support pillars

branchingsupport_pillar_widening_factor.label: Branchingsupport pillar widening factor
branchingsupport_pillar_widening_factor.tooltip: Merging bridges or pillars into another pillars can increase the radius. Zero means no increase, one means full increase. The exact amount of increase is unspecified and can change in the future.

branchingsupport_small_pillar_diameter_p.label: Branchingsupport small pillar diameter percent
branchingsupport_small_pillar_diameter_p.tooltip: The percentage of smaller pillars compared to the normal pillar diameter which are used in problematic areas where a normal pilla cannot fit.

support_base_diameter.label: Support base diameter
support_base_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the pillar base

support_base_height.label: Support base height
support_base_height.tooltip: The height of the pillar base cone

support_base_safety_distance.label: Support base safety distance
support_base_safety_distance.tooltip: The minimum distance of the pillar base from the model in mm. Makes sense in zero elevation mode where a gap according to this parameter is inserted between the model and the pad.

support_buildplate_only.label: Support buildplate only
support_buildplate_only.tooltip: Only create support if it lies on a build plate. Don't create support on a print.

support_critical_angle.label: Support critical angle
support_critical_angle.tooltip: The default angle for connecting support sticks and junctions.

support_enforcers_only.label: Support enforcers only
support_enforcers_only.tooltip: Only create support if it lies in a support enforcer.

support_head_front_diameter.label: Support head front diameter
support_head_front_diameter.tooltip: Diameter of the pointing side of the head

support_head_penetration.label: Support head penetration
support_head_penetration.tooltip: How much the pinhead has to penetrate the model surface

support_head_width.label: Support head width
support_head_width.tooltip: Width from the back sphere center to the front sphere center

support_max_bridge_length.label: Support max bridge length
support_max_bridge_length.tooltip: The max length of a bridge

support_max_pillar_link_distance.label: Support max pillar link distance
support_max_pillar_link_distance.tooltip: The max distance of two pillars to get linked with each other. A zero value will prohibit pillar cascading.

support_max_weight_on_model.label: Support max weight on model
support_max_weight_on_model.tooltip: Maximum weight of sub-trees that terminate on the model instead of the print bed. The weight is the sum of the lenghts of all branches emanating from the endpoint.

support_object_elevation.label: Support object elevation
support_object_elevation.tooltip: How much the supports should lift up the supported object. If "Pad around object" is enabled, this value is ignored.

support_pillar_diameter.label: Support pillar diameter
support_pillar_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the support pillars

support_pillar_widening_factor.label: Support pillar widening factor
support_pillar_widening_factor.tooltip: Merging bridges or pillars into another pillars can increase the radius. Zero means no increase, one means full increase. The exact amount of increase is unspecified and can change in the future.

support_points_density_relative.label: Support points density relative
support_points_density_relative.tooltip: This is a relative measure of support points density.

support_small_pillar_diameter_percent.label: Support small pillar diameter percent
support_small_pillar_diameter_percent.tooltip: The percentage of smaller pillars compared to the normal pillar diameter which are used in problematic areas where a normal pilla cannot fit.
